prompt: Design a 9:16 vertical pet-themed wedding invitation for mobile social sharing. It is intended for invited friends and family, using text-light information density. The reading order is: identify the theme, confirm the context, and finally receive the gentle invitation. The core concept: Naming a 'Dog's Wedding' as a companion ceremony worth attending seriously. The core visual language must be 'Real objects crossing geometric emotional windows': set a narrow, vertical, low-saturation geometric color block amidst large areas of warm white and light grey-beige whitespace as a visual anchor and spatial container. The window features a soft gradient of mist rose, light apricot, and warm grey with clear but non-enclosing boundaries. Two real small companion dogs (one cream/apricot, one natural) peek from different heights of the window, their gaze meeting near the title; heads, paws, and low-saturation wreaths or ribbons partially cross the boundary into the whitespace, capturing a single moment: real life crossing the ceremony frame to meet and be witnessed. No running, jumping, or complex scenes. The dogs must have high-end editorial photography quality: real fluffy fur, natural poses, moist noses, clear eye reflections; shot from a three-quarter perspective slightly below eye level, medium close-up, with soft morning window light, low contrast, and matte printing texture. Maintain continuous quiet whitespace; include only subtle wreath lines or hair outlines, no irrelevant patterns or icons. Text must be accurate and readable, using these exact words: 1. 'The Dog's Wedding' (狗狗的婚礼) - Main title, centrally located between the dogs' gaze. 2. 'Invitation' (邀请函) - Small kicker near the top. 3. 'Wedding' (婚礼) - Contextual tag. 4. 'May every piece of affection come to witness this encounter.' (愿每一份喜欢，都来见证这一场相遇。) - Emotional tagline in the whitespace. 5. 'With blessings, attend a ceremony about companionship.' (带着祝福，赴一场关于陪伴的仪式。) - Closing copy in the lower whitespace. Typography should use a modern Song-style skeleton with narrow characters and a manual, aesthetic feel. Colors focus on warm white, light grey-beige, and muted rose/apricot gradients, avoiding bright or neon colors. The style should reflect Oriental whitespace, modern order, and light luxury quality. Prohibited items include: bright red, neon colors, rainbows, heavy shadows, cartoons, 3D, generic stock photos, QR codes, or irrelevant RSVP/location info. THEORY_LOGIC = SET[Information Arrangement :: Visual Hierarchy :: Gestalt Principles :: Cognitive Load :: Mobile Design] || SYNTHESIS[Using information orchestration as the axis to establish a reading sequence of naming, understanding, then feeling; explicitly omitting unknown dates/locations to focus on the companion ceremony.] METAPHOR_LOGIC = REQUIRED::Dog's Wedding::Two real lives entering a witnessed companionship ceremony::Warm and romantic tension between solemn ritual and natural dog life postures::Real dogs peeking from a ritual frame::Text names the ceremony while images present intimacy, framing 'wedding' as a celebration of companionship.
